latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — automates daily lead generation for local service businesses in the US.

- Runs a daily 6am job to produce 25+ qualified leads per target city/industry.
- Uses specific ICP filtering to ensure high-quality, non-chain, established business prospects.
- Assigns leads a contact completeness tier and matches best sales pitch angle.
- Outputs daily CSVs ready for sales automation tracking, plus a summary notes file.
- Enforces strict data quality: all leads are real, verified, and never fabricated.
